name: xevyra-monorepo
description: XEVYRA - Production-Grade Mobile-First Fitness Tracking Platform

scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@xevyra/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@xevyra/web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@xevyra/web run build && npm --workspace=@xevyra/api run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const paths = ['dist', '.next', 'apps/api/dist', 'apps/web/.next', 'packages/shared/dist', 'packages/domain/dist', 'packages/validation/dist', 'packages/contracts/dist', 'packages/config/dist']; paths.forEach(d => { try { fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch {} });"
